from PIL import Image
im=Image.open('chess_board.png').convert('RGB')
px=im.load(); sq=80
LIGHT=(240,217,181); DARK=(181,136,99)
def d(c,b): return abs(c[0]-b[0])+abs(c[1]-b[1])+abs(c[2]-b[2])
def bgof(f,rank):
    c=px[f*sq+3,(8-rank)*sq+3]
    return LIGHT if d(c,LIGHT)<d(c,DARK) else DARK
def cls(c,bg):
    dd=d(c,bg)
    if dd<45: return '.'
    br=sum(c)
    if br<260: return '#'
    if br>690: return 'O'
    return '+'
def render(f,rank,size=40):
    bg=bgof(f,rank); ry=8-rank
    out=[]
    step=sq//size
    for gy in range(size):
        line=''
        for gx in range(size):
            cnt={'.':0,'#':0,'O':0,'+':0}
            for yy in range(step):
                for xx in range(step):
                    c=px[f*sq+gx*step+xx, ry*sq+gy*step+yy]
                    cnt[cls(c,bg)]+=1
            # prefer non-bg if at least 2 non-bg
            nonbg={k:v for k,v in cnt.items() if k!='.'}
            if sum(nonbg.values())>=2:
                line+=max(nonbg,key=nonbg.get)
            else: line+='.'
        out.append(line)
    return out
names=['a1','a3','b2','c1','c3','e1','e2','e5','f2','g2','h1','h5']
for nm in names:
    f=ord(nm[0])-97; rank=int(nm[1])
    print('=== '+nm+' white ===')
    for l in render(f,rank): print(l)
"
EOF

import numpy as np
im=Image.open('chess_board.png').convert('RGB')
arr=np.asarray(im).astype(int)
sq=80
LIGHT=np.array([240,217,181]); DARK=np.array([181,136,99])
def bgof(f,rank):
    c=arr[(8-rank)*sq+3, f*sq+3]
    return LIGHT if np.abs(c-LIGHT).sum()<np.abs(c-DARK).sum() else DARK
# target masks for occupied squares
squares=[('a1',0,1,'w'),('a3',0,3,'w'),('b2',1,2,'w'),('c1',2,1,'w'),('c3',2,3,'w'),('e1',4,1,'w'),('e2',4,2,'w'),('e5',4,5,'w'),('f2',5,2,'w'),('g2',6,2,'w'),('h1',7,1,'w'),('h5',7,5,'w'),
('a6',0,6,'b'),('a8',0,8,'b'),('b7',1,7,'b'),('c6',2,6,'b'),('c8',2,8,'b'),('d5',3,5,'b'),('d8',3,8,'b'),('e6',4,6,'b'),('f5',5,5,'b'),('f7',5,7,'b'),('f8',5,8,'b'),('g5',6,5,'b'),('g7',6,7,'b')]
def target_mask(f,rank):
    ry=8-rank; bg=bgof(f,rank)
    sub=arr[ry*sq:(ry+1)*sq, f*sq:(f+1)*sq,:]
    dist=np.abs(sub-bg).sum(axis=2)
    return dist>80
# candidates
chars={'w':{'K':0x2654,'Q':0x2655,'R':0x2656,'B':0x2657,'N':0x2658,'P':0x2659},
       'b':{'K':0x265A,'Q':0x265B,'R':0x265C,'B':0x265D,'N':0x265E,'P':0x265F}}
fontpath='/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf'

def cand(ch,size):
    key=(ch,size)
    if key in cache: return cache[key]
    img=Image.new('L',(sq,sq),0)
    d=ImageDraw.Draw(img)
    ft=ImageFont.truetype(fontpath,size)
    d.text((sq/2,sq/2),chr(ch),fill=255,font=ft,anchor='mm')
    m=np.asarray(img)>100
    cache[key]=m
    return m
def best_score(tm,color):
    best=(-1,None,None,None)
    for name,ch in chars[color].items():
        for size in range(38,72):
            m0=cand(ch,size)
            if m0.sum()<20: continue
            for dy in range(-6,7,2):
                for dx in range(-6,7,2):
                    m=np.zeros((sq,sq),bool)
                    ys0=max(0,dy); ys1=min(sq,sq+dy); xs0=max(0,dx); xs1=min(sq,sq+dx)
                    m[ys0:ys1,xs0:xs1]=m0[ys0-dy:ys1-dy,xs0-dx:xs1-dx]
                    inter=(tm&m).sum(); union=(tm|m).sum()
                    sc=inter/union if union else 0
                    if sc>best[0]: best=(sc,name,size,(dx,dy))
    return best
for nm,f,rank,color in squares:
    tm=target_mask(f,rank)
    sc,name,size,off=best_score(tm,color)
    print(f'{nm} {color}: best={name} score={sc:.3f} size={size} off={off} targpix={tm.sum()}')
"

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import numpy as np
im=Image.open('chess_board.png').convert('RGB')
arr=np.asarray(im).astype(int); sq=80
LIGHT=np.array([240,217,181]); DARK=np.array([181,136,99])
def bgof(f,rank):
    c=arr[(8-rank)*sq+3, f*sq+3]
    return LIGHT if np.abs(c-LIGHT).sum()<np.abs(c-DARK).sum() else DARK
def tmask(f,rank):
    ry=8-rank; bg=bgof(f,rank)
    sub=arr[ry*sq:(ry+1)*sq, f*sq:(f+1)*sq,:]
    return (np.abs(sub-bg).sum(axis=2)>80)
def bbox(m):
    ys,xs=np.where(m)
    return xs.min(),ys.min(),xs.max()+1,ys.max()+1
chars={'w':{'K':0x2654,'Q':0x2655,'R':0x2656,'B':0x2657,'N':0x2658,'P':0x2659},
       'b':{'K':0x265A,'Q':0x265B,'R':0x265C,'B':0x265D,'N':0x265E,'P':0x265F}}
fonts={'Sans':'/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf','SansBold':'/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf','Serif':'/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSerif.ttf','SerifBold':'/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSerif-Bold.ttf','Mono':'/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSansMono.ttf','MonoBold':'/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSansMono-Bold.ttf'}
def render(ch,fontpath,px=240):
    img=Image.new('L',(px,px),0); d=ImageDraw.Draw(img)
    ft=ImageFont.truetype(fontpath,px*4//5)
    d.text((px/2,px/2),chr(ch),fill=255,font=ft,anchor='mm')
    return np.asarray(img)>100
def norm_crop(m,shape):
    x0,y0,x1,y1=bbox(m); crop=Image.fromarray((m[y0:y1,x0:x1]*255).astype(np.uint8))
    crop=crop.resize((shape[1],shape[0]),Image.NEAREST)
    return np.asarray(crop)>127
squares=[('e1',4,1,'w'),('e2',4,2,'w'),('a3',0,3,'w'),('c1',2,1,'w'),('c3',2,3,'w'),('a1',0,1,'w'),

    scores=[]
    for fn,fp in fonts.items():
        for name,ch in chars[color].items():
            cm=render(ch,fp); cc=norm_crop(cm,(hh,ww))
            tt=tm[y0:y1,x0:x1]
            inter=(tt&cc).sum(); union=(tt|cc).sum(); iou=inter/union if union else 0

    print(f'{nm} {color} bbox={ww}x{hh}: {top}')
"
